Removed cards do not enter the exhaust pile.
BS_ANCIENT_CARD_RED_QUEEN_MIRROR_DRAW_TO: Remove all cards in your discard pile and put copies of all cards in your draw pile into your discard pile. Removed cards do not enter the exhaust pile.
BS_ANCIENT_CARD_RED_QUEEN_MIRROR_DISCARD: Remove all cards in your draw pile and put copies of all cards in your discard pile into your draw pile. Removed cards do not enter the exhaust pile.

BS_ANCIENT_CARD_JACK_THE_RIPPER_REFLECTI: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Only this card gains [blue]{DamageGain}[/blue] damage. All [gold]Jack[/gold] cards share a count; play them [blue]{JackPlaysRemaining}[/blue] more times to gain [gold]Virtue of Duality[/gold]. Lose [red]{SanLoss}[/red] SAN.
